rationale: The stock has gapped down ~47% on unknown catalyst (no news available), which creates fundamental uncertainty about whether this is a dead-cat bounce or the beginning of stabilization; without a clear narrative, the directional edge is essentially a coin flip. Price has recovered to 76% of today's range and is pressing toward the $15.00 high-of-day resistance, but the final candle showed a sharp volume collapse (~28k vs 140–200k prior candles) suggesting momentum exhaustion without a clean resolution of direction. With today's realized P&L already negative and loss budget limited to ~$895, initiating a position in a high-volatility, low-information environment does not justify the risk.
